# extend git state

Add the remotes to the `git state` screen ([[DOT-92]]), fetch URLs only, so that it is obvious at a glance whether the checkout has a `mirror` or `upstream` configured. The target layout:

```bash
$ git state
Remotes:
origin  git@github.com:kamilsk/dotfiles.git (fetch)
mirror git@bitbucket.org:kamilsk/dotfiles.git (fetch)

На ветке master
Ваша ветка обновлена в соответствии с «origin/master».

нечего коммитить, нет изменений в рабочем каталоге

Stash content
-

Latest release: no have any release
```

(the middle block is a Russian-locale `git status`).
